text: I can explain the difference between continuous integration, continuous delivery and continuous deployment in one sentence each.
I can lay out a deployment pipeline with stages ordered by cost and give each a time budget, keeping the commit stage under 10 minutes.
I can compute how per-test flake rates compound across a suite (0.995^200 ≈ 37% green) and say how I would fix it.
I can explain why we build once and deploy by image digest, and how config differs per environment without a rebuild.
I can name what makes a rollback unsafe (schema, message formats, external side effects) and write an automated rollback trigger.
